description: Word list digests: SHA-256 over a 4-byte little-endian entry count, followed by each entry as a 4-byte little-endian byte length and its raw bytes, in word list order. 'synthetic-3-word' is a minimal worked example implementers can reproduce by hand; 'bip39-english' is the canonical 2048-word list shipped in github.com/FortegoSwiss/codebook-cipher/wordlist/bip39. Every digestHex value here, including bip39-english's, is project-normative: it is this project's own List.Digest() encoding, not an externally published digest. bip39-english's word *list* is externally anchored -- its raw wordlist.txt content is checked against the published upstream english.txt file's plain SHA-256 in wordlist/bip39/wordlist_test.go's canonicalEnglishSHA256 constant -- but that is a different hash, over different bytes, of the same words; it will not equal digestHex.

vectors.name: bip39-english
